from sklearn.linear_model import LogisticRegression
import numpy as np

# Prepare the data for logistic regression
X = df[['INCOME']].values.reshape(-1, 1)  # Predictor
y = df['SAMESAVE'].values  # Response

# Create a logistic regression model
model = LogisticRegression()
model.fit(X, y)

# Get the coefficient and standard error
coefficient = model.coef_[0][0]
standard_error = np.sqrt(model.score(X, y))  # Approximation of standard error

# Calculate the z-score
z_score = coefficient / standard_error

# Calculate the p-value using the z-score
p_value = 2 * (1 - np.abs(z_score))  # Two-tailed p-value
coefficient, p_value
